evidences.doc_title: The Geology of the Country Around Holmfirth and Glossop (excerpt)
evidences.text:
GENERAL STRATIGRAPHY
The Shale Grit forms a wide spread on the moors in the
southern part of the Sheet, where it is 450 to 550 feet'thick.It is
also cxposed in the valleys of the Etherow and Tame. In the
south it consists of grits and sandstones with frcquent thin sandy
shale beds and less frequent thicker shale beds; in Longdendale
the exposed part of the series consists of thicker and more massivc
grits, but theexposures in the Tame valley show the beds to be more
like those in the south.

request.message: What is the correlation between attention distributions on label words and the model's final prediction quantified by?

response.answer: The correlation is quantified using the AUC-ROC score. The attention distributions on the label words of the target position are treated as a classifier's prediction, and the AUC-ROC value is computed relative to the actual model output; this is denoted as AUC-ROC_l [E3]. For deep layers, AUC-ROC_l approaches 0.8, indicating a strong correlation [E4].

the model’s final prediction. We use the AUC-

diction for the model output label (that is, Al(q, pi)

Figures 5a and 5b delineate correlation metrics for

The AUCROCl for deep layers approaches 0.8, il-

distributions on label words of the target position
and the model’s final prediction. Moreover, shal-
low layers show negligible cumulative contribu-
tions (Rl), with a significant increase in middle and
deep layers.

evidences.text:
### invoice
销售发票，含客户、开票时间、账单地址及发票总额
| 字段 | 数据类型 | 可为空 | 中文说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| invoice_id | integer | 否 | 发票编号 |
| customer_id | integer | 否 | 客户编号 |
| invoice_date | timestamp without time zone | 否 | 开票时间，不是客户创建时间 |
| billing_address | character varying(70) | 是 | 发票账单街道地址 |
| billing_city | character varying(40) | 是 | 发票账单城市 |
| billing_state | character varying(40) | 是 | 发票账单州或省，可为空 |
| billing_country | character varying(40) | 是 | 发票账单地址国家，与 customer.country 是不同字段，不可直接互换 |

evidences.text:
### customer
客户及其所在地、联系方式、销售支持员工
| 字段 | 数据类型 | 可为空 | 中文说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| customer_id | integer | 否 | 客户编号 |
| first_name | character varying(40) | 否 | 名字 |
| last_name | character varying(20) | 否 | 姓氏 |
| company | character varying(80) | 是 | 客户公司名称，可为空 |
| address | character varying(70) | 是 | 所在地街道地址 |
| city | character varying(40) | 是 | 所在地城市 |
| state | character varying(40) | 是 | 所在地州或省，可为空 |
| country | character varying(40) | 是 | 所在地国家，使用原始英文标准值，例如 USA、Brazil |
